# MoveAlongPath

Qualified name: `manim.animation.movement.MoveAlongPath`

class MoveAlongPath(*mobject=None*, *\*args*, *use\_override=True*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Animation`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.animation.Animation.html#manim.animation.animation.Animation "manim.animation.animation.Animation")

    Make one mobject move along the path of another mobject.

    Example: MoveAlongPathExample

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/MoveAlongPathExample-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class MoveAlongPathExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            d1 = Dot().set_color(ORANGE)
            l1 = Line(LEFT, RIGHT)
            l2 = VMobject()
            self.add(d1, l1, l2)
            l2.add_updater(lambda x: x.become(Line(LEFT, d1.get_center()).set_color(ORANGE)))
            self.play(MoveAlongPath(d1, l1), rate_func=linear)
    ```
